description: This file defines the ModelAction interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package, which specifies methods for executing actions within the widget model framework and accepting visitors.

classes.name: ModelAction
classes.description: An interface representing actions within the OFBiz widget model, with methods to execute the action and accept visitors.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor that implements ModelActionVisitor, allowing external operations on the action.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the action with the provided context map, potentially throwing a GeneralException.
